technology_approach: A multiplex platform that simultaneously tests for multiple clinically relevant biomarkers against the SARS-CoV-2 virus: three virus proteins (Spike 1, Spike 2 & N) and three classes of antibodies (IgM, IgG and IgA), giving a quantitative profile of the patient's immune response.
sensitivity_claim: Attomarker's Triple Antibody test delivers a sensitivity of up to 96% in detecting COVID-19 antibodies, including in patients who have previously presented negative swab tests.

evaluating immune effects of virus versus mRNA vaccine technology (Spike Protein Test)

why_worth_studying: Attomarker shows a clear, repeatable playbook for a university spin-out with a physics-based, label-free multiplex protein/antibody detection platform: fast pivot of an EPSRC-funded research idea into a real-world clinical validation (St Thomas' Hospital) within weeks of a crisis, rapid regulatory clearance (MHRA/CE/UKCA), a manufacturing partnership with an established industrial player (Smiths Detection) to scale production, and now diversification into a broader immune-profiling pipeline (Long COVID endotyping, liver, fertility, allergy) plus non-dilutive/crowd equity funding routes (Exeter alumni appeal, Crowdcube Acceleration Round) and disease-area co-development deals (EpitogenX).
